{
  "title": "The Great Gatsby — Opening Arrival",

  "style_bible": {
    "visual_period": "United States, 1915–1922: Middle West to Long Island, summer 1922",
    "line_and_color": "Clean, precise ink lines with restrained color; sandy neutrals and cool bay blues punctuated by warm golds and ivy greens; occasional double-exposure overlays for metaphor.",
    "lighting": "Golden hour exteriors; crisp summer sunlight; lamplit interiors with soft shadows; dusk blues over the bay.",
    "lettering": "Narration captions in elegant serif italics; dialogue in clean uppercase sans; sound effects small and unobtrusive.",
    "recurring_motifs": [
      "Dust motes drifting in light",
      "Seismograph needle and paper ribbon",
      "Red-and-gold book spines",
      "Egg shapes and shorelines",
      "Raw ivy creeping on stone",
      "Water of Long Island Sound shimmering at dusk"
    ]
  },
  "characters": [
    {
      "name": "Nick Carraway",
      "visual_anchor": "Slim, clean-shaven man in his mid-20s; neatly parted brown hair; observant gray-blue eyes; reserved posture.",
      "costume": "1922 light wool suit (tan or gray), white shirt, slim tie, straw boater or flat cap as needed; in college/war flashbacks: Yale sweater or WWI doughboy uniform.",
      "expression_range": "Subtle: thoughtful, politely attentive, faintly amused, quietly weary.",
      "continuity_note": "Keep Nick’s hair part, lean build, and understated dress consistent; he often stands slightly apart from others, hands in pockets or holding a notebook/book."
    },
    {
      "name": "Nick’s Father",
      "visual_anchor": "Older gentleman with neat silver-streaked hair and small mustache; calm, direct gaze.",
      "costume": "Dark three-piece suit with pocket watch chain; white shirt; conservative tie.",
      "expression_range": "Measured warmth; gently instructive.",
      "continuity_note": "Appears only in memory; keep porch setting and twilight tone consistent."
    },
    {
      "name": "Confiding Young Men (composite)",
      "visual_anchor": "Assorted college-age men with loosened ties or varsity sweaters; slightly haggard or intense looks.",
      "costume": "1910s collegiate attire: shirtsleeves, vests, lettered sweaters.",
      "expression_range": "Anxious, over-eager, conspiratorial.",
      "continuity_note": "Use as background foils; avoid distinct anchors so they read as various ‘wild, unknown men.’"
    },
    {
      "name": "Finnish Housekeeper",
      "visual_anchor": "Sturdy middle-aged woman with kerchief over hair and kind, lined face; practical stance.",
      "costume": "Simple long skirt, rolled sleeves, apron; sensible shoes.",
      "expression_range": "Stoic, murmuring concentration; occasional curt nod.",
      "continuity_note": "Always near the stove or housekeeping tasks; include small muttered SFX rather than dialogue."
    },
    {
      "name": "Direction-Seeking Man",
      "visual_anchor": "Newly arrived young man with soft hat and travel-creased suit; earnest, a bit lost.",
      "costume": "Light summer suit with loosened tie; scuffed shoes; carrying a folded timetable.",
      "expression_range": "Puzzled, hopeful.",
      "continuity_note": "Appears only once on the country road; keep him hat-in-hand when he asks."
    },
    {
      "name": "Jay Gatsby (distant presence)",
      "visual_anchor": "Handsome man mid-30s seen in silhouette or at a distance; straight posture; slicked dark hair.",
      "costume": "Evening wear or immaculate light suit depending on scene; no close facial detail yet.",
      "expression_range": "Unreadable, intent (implied).",
      "continuity_note": "Show him as a silhouette/figure on terrace or near water; withhold close facial features until later chapters."
    }
  ],
  "pages": [
    {
      "page_number": 1,
      "page_summary": "Nick recalls his father’s advice and his habit of reserving judgment, with glimpses of college confidences and the limits of his tolerance.",
      "panels": [
        {
          "panel_number": 1,
          "beat": "Father’s advice on withholding criticism.",
          "shot": "medium",
          "image_prompt": "1910s Middle Western front porch at twilight; Nick as a teenager sits beside his father on wooden chairs; father leans forward, hand gently raised, giving counsel. Fireflies hover; a quiet street and elm trees in soft purple dusk. Period suits: father in dark three-piece, young Nick in simple shirt and suspenders. Warm lamplight from inside spills onto the porch.",
          "caption": "In my younger and more vulnerable years my father gave me advice.",
          "dialogue": [
            {
              "speaker": "Father",
              "text": "Whenever you feel like criticizing anyone, remember not everyone had your advantages."
            }
          ],
          "sfx": [
            "CRICK-CRICK (crickets)"
          ],
          "continuity_notes": "Establish young Nick’s look for later recognition; father’s measured tone.",
          "source_anchor": "\"Whenever you feel like criticizing anyone... advantages that you've had.\""
        },
        {
          "panel_number": 2,
          "beat": "Nick’s habit of reserving judgments opens confidences—and bores.",
          "shot": "medium",
          "image_prompt": "1910s college dorm common room at night; Nick, older now, sits on a threadbare couch, posture attentive but reserved; a disheveled student leans in, whispering intensely. Books and empty coffee cups litter a table; a green-shaded desk lamp casts moody pools of light.",
          "caption": "So I reserve all judgments. It opens curious natures to me—and not a few veteran bores.",
          "dialogue": [
            {
              "speaker": "Confider",
              "text": "You can’t tell anyone—"
            }
          ],
          "sfx": [],
          "continuity_notes": "Keep Nick’s calm listening pose; composite confider can vary later.",
          "source_anchor": "\"I'm inclined to reserve all judgements... victim of not a few veteran bores.\""
        },
        {
          "panel_number": 3,
          "beat": "Feigning sleep to avoid another ‘intimate revelation.’",
          "shot": "wide",
          "image_prompt": "Dormitory bunk room; late night. Nick lies on a narrow bed, eyes closed, one arm over his face, coat hanging on a hook. Another student stands in the doorway, hesitant, about to speak. A single bare bulb glows.",
          "caption": "Often I feigned sleep when an intimate revelation quivered on the horizon.",
          "dialogue": [
            {
              "speaker": "Confider",
              "text": "I just—"
            }
          ],
          "sfx": [
            "CREAK (door)"
          ],
          "continuity_notes": "Reinforce Nick’s avoidance without speechiness.",
          "source_anchor": "\"Frequently I have feigned sleep... an intimate revelation was quivering on the horizon.\""
        },
        {
          "panel_number": 4,
          "beat": "Accused in college of being a ‘politician’ for knowing secret griefs.",
          "shot": "medium",
          "image_prompt": "College quad by day; Nick walks past bulletin boards while two students whisper and glance his way. Autumn leaves on the ground; a stone building backdrop.",
          "caption": "The abnormal mind attaches to this quality. They called me a politician—privy to secret griefs.",
          "dialogue": [
            {
              "speaker": "Student (whisper)",
              "text": "He knows everything."
            }
          ],
          "sfx": [],
          "continuity_notes": "Campus setting contrasts with prior interiors.",
          "source_anchor": "\"I was unjustly accused of being a politician... privy to the secret griefs of wild, unknown men.\""
        },
        {
          "panel_number": 5,
          "beat": "Limits of tolerance; decencies unequally parceled.",
          "shot": "wide",
          "image_prompt": "City sidewalk afternoon; Nick stands still, hands in pockets, as passersby of different classes stream past: a banker in a topcoat, a laborer with lunch pail, a flapper with beads. Long shadow lines; muted colors.",
          "caption": "Decencies are parceled unequally at birth. Even tolerance has a limit.",
          "dialogue": [],
          "sfx": [],
          "continuity_notes": "Externalize internal thought via contrasting passersby; keep Nick centered, slightly apart.",
          "source_anchor": "\"a sense of the fundamental decencies is parcelled out unequally... I come to the admission that it has a limit.\""
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "page_number": 2,
      "page_summary": "Nick’s post-Eastern reaction, his singular exception for Gatsby, the ‘foul dust,’ and his background leading to the move East.",
      "panels": [
        {
          "panel_number": 1,
          "beat": "After returning last autumn, Nick longs for a world at moral attention.",
          "shot": "wide",
          "image_prompt": "City street in late autumn; a line of uniformed men (soldiers, police) stand at attention along a curb; Nick in civilian suit passes by, posture rigid, eyes forward. Pale sunlight; bare trees.",
          "caption": "After I came back from the East, I wanted the world in uniform—at moral attention.",
          "dialogue": [],
          "sfx": [],
          "continuity_notes": "Temporal cue: ‘last autumn’; cooler palette than summer scenes.",
          "source_anchor": "\"I wanted the world to be in uniform and at a sort of moral attention forever.\""
        },
        {
          "panel_number": 2,
          "beat": "Only Gatsby is exempt; he both offends and fascinates.",
          "shot": "establishing",
          "image_prompt": "Night on Long Island Sound; distant silhouette of a man (Gatsby) on a terrace above dark lawns, looking across the bay; soft party lights behind him; the water glimmers.",
          "caption": "Only Gatsby was exempt—he represented what I scorn, yet there was something gorgeous about him.",
          "dialogue": [],
          "sfx": [],
          "continuity_notes": "Do not reveal Gatsby’s face; emphasize distance and allure.",
          "source_anchor": "\"Only Gatsby... was exempt... there was something gorgeous about him.\""
        },
        {
          "panel_number": 3,
          "beat": "Gatsby’s sensitivity like a machine registering distant earthquakes.",
          "shot": "detail",
          "image_prompt": "Close on an early 20th-century seismograph: brass arm tapping a moving paper ribbon. Double-exposure overlay: faint profile of Gatsby’s silhouette aligned with the needle’s tremor.",
          "caption": "A heightened sensitivity—an extraordinary gift for hope.",
          "dialogue": [],
          "sfx": [
            "TICK…TICK…"
          ],
          "continuity_notes": "Introduce the seismograph motif for reuse; keep overlay subtle.",
          "source_anchor": "\"as if he were related to one of those intricate machines that register earthquakes... an extraordinary gift for hope.\""
        },
        {
          "panel_number": 4,
          "beat": "‘Foul dust’ in the wake of Gatsby’s dreams.",
          "shot": "wide",
          "image_prompt": "Dusk over the bay; a small motorboat’s wake ripples toward shore; in the air above the water, dust-like motes swirl in the last light, mingled with stray confetti.",
          "caption": "He turned out all right. It was the foul dust in the wake of his dreams that closed my interest in short-winded elations.",
          "dialogue": [],
          "sfx": [
            "RRRR (distant motor)"
          ],
          "continuity_notes": "Set up ‘dust’ as a recurring visual; keep colors somber blue-violets.",
          "source_anchor": "\"what foul dust floated in the wake of his dreams... closed out my interest...\""
        },
        {
          "panel_number": 5,
          "beat": "Background: Middle West, Yale, the war; restlessness and decision to go East.",
          "shot": "wide",
          "image_prompt": "Triptych montage: 1) Formal family portrait in a Middle Western parlor; 2) Yale 1915 diploma with mortarboard on a table; 3) Nick in WWI uniform crouched in a trench; 4) Seamless into a spring 1922 train roaring east past green fields.",
          "caption": "Prominent Middle West. Yale ’15. The war. Restless—I went East to learn the bond business.",
          "dialogue": [],
          "sfx": [
            "CLACK-CLACK (train)"
          ],
          "continuity_notes": "Anchor dates subtly (1915, spring ’22) via props; keep Nick identifiable across vignettes.",
          "source_anchor": "\"My family have been prominent... Yale in 1915... the Great War... so I decided to go East and learn the bond business.\""
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "page_number": 3,
      "page_summary": "Nick’s West Egg setup: the bungalow, Finnish housekeeper, brief dog, first neighborly exchange, summer’s fresh start, and the Eggs—culminating in Gatsby’s colossal mansion beside Nick’s small house.",
      "panels": [
        {
          "panel_number": 1,
          "beat": "The weather-beaten bungalow at eighty a month; roommate sent to Washington.",
          "shot": "establishing",
          "image_prompt": "Morning in a quiet coastal commuting town; a small weathered shingle bungalow with a sagging porch near the water; wild grass; a paper tacked inside the window (rent $80/month). Nick arrives with a suitcase; a second suitcase sits abandoned on the porch with a telegram atop: ‘Ordered to Washington.’",
          "caption": "A weather-beaten cardboard bungalow at eighty a month. My would-be roommate went to Washington; I went alone.",
          "dialogue": [],
          "sfx": [
            "GULLS"
          ],
          "continuity_notes": "Place the house near visible water to foreshadow proximity to the Sound.",
          "source_anchor": "\"a weather-beaten cardboard bungalow at eighty a month... the firm ordered him to Washington, and I went out... alone.\""
        },
        {
          "panel_number": 2,
          "beat": "A few-day dog, old Dodge, and the Finnish woman at the electric stove.",
          "shot": "medium",
          "image_prompt": "Cozy kitchen interior; morning sun; the Finnish housekeeper stirs a pan on an electric stove, muttering. Nick sits at a small table with coffee; on a wall hook hangs an empty dog leash and collar. Through a window, an old Dodge car is parked in a sandy drive.",
          "caption": "I had a dog—for a few days—an old Dodge, and a Finnish woman who cooked and murmured wisdom to herself over the electric stove.",
          "dialogue": [],
          "sfx": [
            "HUM (stove)",
            "MUTTER MUTTER"
          ],
          "continuity_notes": "Keep the Dodge’s silhouette consistent in later exterior shots.",
          "source_anchor": "\"I had a dog—at least I had him for a few days... and a Finnish woman... muttered... over the electric stove.\""
        },
        {
          "panel_number": 3,
          "beat": "A newer arrival asks Nick the way to West Egg village.",
          "shot": "medium",
          "image_prompt": "Sunny country road lined with hedges and new leaves; the Direction-Seeking Man, hat in hand, looks helpless; Nick gestures down the road, relaxed now. A glimpse of bay water at the turn ahead.",
          "caption": "Lonely, until a man newer than I stopped me on the road.",
          "dialogue": [
            {
              "speaker": "Stranger",
              "text": "How do you get to West Egg village?"
            },
            {
              "speaker": "Nick",
              "text": "Straight on, then left by the Sound."
            }
          ],
          "sfx": [],
          "continuity_notes": "Establish neighborly tone; same road returns visually in later Long Island sequences.",
          "source_anchor": "\"'How do you get to West Egg village?' he asked helplessly.\""
        },
        {
          "panel_number": 4,
          "beat": "Summer’s restart; red-and-gold books like new money.",
          "shot": "detail",
          "image_prompt": "Interior shelf close-up: a neat row of a dozen red-and-gold spined volumes titled ‘Banking,’ ‘Credit,’ ‘Investment Securities’; sunbeams cut dust in the air; faint reflection of bay light. Inset: Nick at a single window, reading.",
          "caption": "With sunshine and bursting leaves, life began over again. I bought red-and-gold books—like new money from the mint.",
          "dialogue": [],
          "sfx": [
            "RUSTLE (leaves)"
          ],
          "continuity_notes": "Introduce the ‘single window’ reading posture as Nick’s POV motif.",
          "source_anchor": "\"bursts of leaves... life was beginning over again... I bought a dozen volumes... in red and gold like new money from the mint.\""
        },
        {
          "panel_number": 5,
          "beat": "The two Eggs and Gatsby’s colossal mansion beside Nick’s tiny house.",
          "shot": "wide",
          "image_prompt": "Aerial-like view of two egg-shaped peninsulas jutting into Long Island Sound under bright summer light; LEFT labeled ‘West Egg’ (less fashionable), RIGHT labeled ‘East Egg.’ Foreground lower strip: Nick’s small shingled house perched at the tip of West Egg, fifty yards from the water, squeezed between two vast estates. On the right estate: a spanking-new stone mansion imitating a Normandy town hall, with a single tower, raw ivy just starting, a marble swimming pool glinting, and sweeping lawns across forty acres.",
          "caption": "That riotous island of two enormous Eggs. I lived at West Egg—my small house pinched between vast places. To my right stood a colossal imitation of a Normandy Hôtel de Ville—Gatsby’s mansion.",
          "dialogue": [],
          "sfx": [],
          "continuity_notes": "Keep mansion features consistent: tower, raw ivy, marble pool, vast lawn; do not show Gatsby up close.",
          "source_anchor": "\"two unusual formations... a pair of enormous eggs... I lived at West Egg... My house... squeezed between two huge places... a factual imitation of some Hôtel de Ville in Normandy... It was Gatsby's mansion.\""
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
